The execution failed due to incorrect cost-benefit calculations resulting in significant numerical discrepancies in campaign margins and totals.
The verifier reported 'call_failed' in test_output.py with a reward of 0.00. Specifically, test_rows_and_order failed with 'close(468.0, 7956.0)' returning False, indicating a logic error in campaign-level math. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed because the calculated total_annual_margin_6_day_usd was -45894.84 instead of the expected -83406.84. Avoid current margin calculation logic as it produced a 45% variance from expected values.
